title: Investigate elevated 5xx responses and unhealthy targets
body: First compare the start time of the errors with recent deployments or configuration changes. Check target health and the health-check path, port, timeout, and expected response code. Compare load-balancer access logs with application logs using timestamps and request IDs. If unhealthy targets began immediately after a rollout, pause or roll back according to the service owner's deployment procedure. Do not declare a root cause until the application and target-health evidence agree.

title: Investigate HTTP 429 responses and retry pressure
body: Confirm whether 429 responses align with a batch job, traffic increase, or quota boundary. Check request rate, concurrency, and quota metrics. Use exponential backoff with jitter and avoid immediate synchronized retries. Reduce concurrency while validating recovery. Request a quota increase only after confirming expected demand and service limits.
